claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The supplied audio is a low engine rumble.
The car begins in an unlit, garage-like space with a matte floor and featureless black background.
Two round headlights ignite and cast pale beams through the gloom.
The car rolls smoothly toward the camera while the camera tracks with it.

subjects.description: The car from the request, initially hidden in darkness and facing the camera.
Two round headlights mounted on the front of the car.
